content.storyline: This AFC East matchup pits division-leading Buffalo (8-1) against Miami (1-8). It is Miami’s third divisional game of the season.
matchup_notes: Buffalo beat the New York Jets 31-12 in Week 10.
Miami lost its last three games: 24-22 to Indianapolis, 19-9 to Detroit and 24-19 to New England.
Entering Week 11, Buffalo averaged 31.9 points per game (first in the NFL), while Miami averaged 16.4 (30th).
Dolphins quarterback Kyle McCord made his NFL debut in Week 10, completing 17 of 32 passes for 209 yards and adding a rushing touchdown.
